Subject: GPU pool matchmaking & sprint-ready plan (week of Dec 11)

Hi team — kicking off the weekly alignment for Dedicated sizing tied to ACME (RDW-ACME-2309). Goal: produce a sprint-ready allocation we can commit to for Jan-Feb pilot windows and surface any funding/contract asks before EoY procurement.

TL;DR:
- Attached: a short deck (2026-12-week-fleet-deck.pdf) + ACME forecast workbook.
- Proposed immediate ask: reserve 24 x A100-equivalent slots for Jan pilot (4 weeks), with 40% burst available for peak evaluation windows.
- Decision points needed by Tues 12/14: finance signoff on committed runrate; infra confirmation on pool mapping; sales to confirm target acceptance tests.

Key numbers from ACME (high level):
- ACME expects 250k inference tokens/day for pilot, rising to ~1.2M after production ramp (Q1).
- Benchmark target: p95 latency <= 120ms for 2k TPS synthetic load.

Asks by role:
- Ben (Infra): confirm whether 24 reserved slots + 40% burst fits current Dedicated pool fragmentation and whether a convertible burst policy is feasible.
- Laura (Finance): provide rough committed spend delta and whether we can push partial invoice in Jan.
- Karthik (Sales Ops): confirm quota/contract wording for burst eligibility and fallback model variants.
- Sara / ACME: please attach any additional forecast rows (we only had the slide-level numbers).

I'll run a short sync Tues 12/14 16:00 EST (invite to follow) unless someone asks to move.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Account Lead, Strategic Deals
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2026-12-week-fleet-deck.pdf (slides), acme_forecast_q1_2027.xlsx (workbook)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sara Hamilton <sara.hamilton@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: GPU pool matchmaking & sprint-ready plan (week of Dec 11)

Camila — quick infra read. Thanks for the deck. High level: 24 A100-equivalent reserved slots is reasonable from a raw capacity perspective, but two operational caveats:

1) Fragmentation: current Dedicated pools have three active reservations next month that are pinned to different hardware families. To guarantee p95 120ms at 2k TPS we would need to pin ACME to the same instance family as the pilot (NVIDIA A100-80GB perf profile). That reduces flexibility for burst mapping to other deals.

2) Cold-start caching for ACME's evals: if they do large batch evals we should provision a short warmup buffer (2–4 nodes) to prime KV caches prior to the run—otherwise first-hour costs look 25% higher.

Proposed mitigations:
- Start with 18 reserved + 6 burst-convertible (policy: burst billed on-demand; if duration exceeds 3 days convert to committed at a pro-rated rate).
- Add a 2-node warmup buffer scheduled 1hr before heavy eval windows (we can automate with deployment hooks).

I can confirm exact node families and pool IDs by Mon 12/13 EOD after a quick inventory check.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Fleet Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pool-mapping-proposal.csv (proposed pool IDs & families)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 13:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: GPU pool matchmaking & sprint-ready plan (week of Dec 11)

Thanks Camila/Ben — finance perspective: we can approve a modified commit for ACME but need clarity on billing cadence and early-conversion exposure. Quick numbers (very rough):

- 18 reserved slots (A100-equivalent) for one month -> incremental committed runrate ~ $78k/month (capex/opex blended).
- 6 burst slots at on-demand pricing (estimated 30% higher) -> hit to cashflow is modest for short bursts but unpredictable conversion events could open ~ $25k one-time exposure.

Requirements for signoff:
- Contract language that caps automatic conversion exposure to max 50% of a single invoice period (we can negotiate).
- A-OK on an invoice milestone tied to the start of the pilot (first month) — procurement at ACME prefers a partial prepay.

I'll coordinate with accounting and send a formal commit delta by EoD Tues 12/14. If ACME can confirm prepay percentage we can accelerate provisioning.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Finance
Redwood Inference
